description: Alloy is a digital health platform built on the belief that women over 40 deserve to feel fantastic—and shouldn’t have to struggle to find the answers they need to do so. By connecting women with menopause-trained doctors, FDA-approved plant-based prescriptions, and a trusted community, Alloy makes it easy to access evidence-based, holistic solutions that deliver real relief now. Alloy empowers women to take charge of their health with confidence, while equipping partners with data-driven insights to better support their needs.

Pushing the boundaries of what responsibly grown and ethically manufactured materials can achieve. By employing fashion as a pathway to activism, Another Tomorrow is delivering end-to-end sustainable luxury to the fashion category. Built on the principles of animal, human and environmental welfare, and in partnership with mission-aligned suppliers around the world, Another Tomorrow is delivering high-quality capsule collections that are ethically and responsibly made – proof that high morals can co-exist with high fashion.

Saving half the women diagnosed with ovarian cancer. AOA has developed the first liquid biopsy test that accurately enables the early diagnosis of ovarian cancer through the analysis of tumor marker gangliosides. With approx. 80% of ovarian cancer cases only detected at stages III and IV, AOA provides the potential to reduce the number of deaths from this diagnosis by half, significantly reduce the costs of treatment and recurrence, and save countless women’s lives.

Reimagining the future of care. Bumo is reimagining care in a post-pandemic world. by integrating childcare (scheduled & on-demand) with co-working spaces to meet today’s working families where they are. Through a combination of corporate and real estate partnerships, Bumo is creating a world where working parents are empowered to work-hard and parent-hard -- with zero guilt and high assurance that their children are learning & growing while they expand and extend their careers.

A social Defi wallet geared at bringing more women into crypto. Clutch has been designed to educate, facilitate investments and nurture an online community space for women investing. Clutch’s vision is to be the first women-focused financial institution for the future of money on web3 through a a safe and inclusive experience where women can transact, invest, and communicate about their experience with crypto.

“Emmeline is run by three powerful, savvy, and helpful businesswomen. The networks they’ve provided have been so helpful for our business and it's only our second month working together. Also having female investors fund a product that will generate more wealth for women is very high impact.”

Fusing simple, high-quality ingredients with essential vitamins and supplements so you don't have to choose between taste and health. Building a plant-based functional foods company where every vegan product is paired with a “function” that is good for you including vitamins, supplements, and boosts. Deux’s vegan offerings start with reinvented desserts including cookie doughs and spreads that can be eaten straight from the jar or baked, and which are enhanced for immune support, collagen support, stress relief, or protein.

Ema is an AI-powered assistant designed to support women's health across all life stages. Ema offers personalized, evidence-based guidance on topics ranging from menstruation to menopause and seamlessly integrating with businesses to deliver tailored resources and actionable data insights. Ema empowers women and their families to take control of their health while seamlessly integrating with businesses to deliver tailored resources and actionable data insights.

Using VR to manage pain and anxiety. Using 30 years of clinical studies, Flowly is redefining how everyday people learn to live with chronic pain, anxiety, and trouble sleeping. Using responsive VR environments, biofeedback training for relaxation, and therapeutic voice-over and music, Flowy is helping users regulate their Autonomic Nervous System without medication. Trusted by world-class hospital systems and academic institutions, and the subject of ongoing NIH studies, Flowly is changing the face of chronic pain management.

Powering innovation, behavioral change, and empowerment across the sexual health & technology industry. Healthy Pleasure Group is the only global outfit w/ the required combination of R&D, agency, and learning capabilities to harness market growth and lead positive behavioral change. With a team of specialists (scientists, marketers, and educators), an IP vault of 20+ ready-to-market products, and serving 60+ clients across four continents, HPG is revolutionizing sexual health & technology through the economic engines of education,product innovation, and investment.

Activating private company growth through the lens of board diversity & effectiveness. Through market-facing content and small cohort experiences, Illumyn is empowering private company boards to better address company growth and scale through the lenses of diversity, cultural change, ESG, and social/geopolitical movements. Illumyn is the for-profit arm of Him for Her, and non-profit accelerating diversity on for-profit boards by bridging the gap between board opportunities and talented women ready for board service.

Bridging the diversity gap for clinical trials. Infiuss is expanding under-represented access to clinical trials through the power of technology, starting with West Africa. Through remote enrollment and participant qualification, Infiuss is ensuring large pharma can deliver equity and representation across their clinical trials – ensuring higher quality care and outcomes for everyone.

Integrating precision medicine with women's mental health for every life stage. LunaJoy is integrating precision medicine with women's mental health to power a digital mental health clinic specialized in every life stage including adolescence, pregnancy, postpartum, infertility, miscarriage, menopause, and aging. LunaJoy provides therapy, medication management, coaching, genetic testing, and support groups via DTC and B2B offerings, all integrated with a woman’s primary care and supported by insurance.

Lōvu Health is a next-generation digital platform dedicated to transforming maternal outcomes through technology, service, and data. Lōvu Health ensures every expectant mother and her baby can equitably access precision care guided by innovative technology and evidence-based insights. Clinicians are able to monitor patients more closely and intervene earlier when necessary, while Lōvu's proprietary recommendation engine helps providers improve patient outcomes and satisfaction.

Helping individuals and enterprises regain their privacy through automation. Malloc is on a mission to make privacy and data security accessible, automated, and effective. With a groundbreaking B2C app called Antistalker they have already helped hundreds of beta users, many of them women, surface spyware, and other rogue data sharing tools embedded on their smartphones. With expertise in artificial intelligence, cyber security, software engineering and innovation management, Malloc is helping people and enterprises protect their data and regain their privacy.

Ending the ‘motherhood penalty.’ Mirza’s mission is to end the “motherhood penalty” by building family financial health with a suite of financial solutions including FSA/HSA, insurance, and Mirza’s own products: securitized “care now, pay later” ISAs, and pension gap-free 401Ks all designed for working parents.

Innovating athletic apparel with feminine wellness in mind. OYA is transforming the technology behind women’s athletic apparel to deliver better ventilation and moisture control where it matters most. In partnership with OB/GYNs, OYA developed a line of athletic apparel with patent-pending ventilation panels and leak absorbent crotch gusset technology to keep vaginas dry and clean, and anti-chafing elastic bands to reduce the likelihood of breast rashes. OYA is making constant OB visits for everyday and pro athletic women a thing of the past.

Raising the next generation of confident girls through better story-telling. Rebel Girls is a global empowerment brand dedicated to raising the most inspired and confident generation of girls through content, experiences, products, and community. Rebel Girls believes in empowering girls to dream big by amplifying stories of real-life, extraordinary women who paved the way to a more equal world. If she can see it, she can be it.

Bringing safety to home dialysis. Relavo is enriching the lives of people with kidney failure by making home dialysis safer and more accessible by changing the way those on Peritoneal Dialysis (PD) receive care. With patent-protected technology called PeritoneX, Relavo has created a solution to internally disinfect dialysis tubes at all connection sites in the PD system. Relavo is guided by patient-centric decision making, a people-first mentality, a willingness to learn, and a focus on diversity and inclusion.

“Emmeline Ventures is a mission-critical add to our cap table. We call them our fairy VC godmothers! They provide measured advice and expert support based on decades of collective business experience. They are women and mothers, and represent the patients we serve—and have even provided direct product feedback that helped shape our patient experience. “

Closing the gap on maternal and postpartum outcomes for Black women by unlocking community and certifying culturally competent care. She Matters is a digital health platform designed to provide Black women with community, culturally relevant resources, and culturally competent therapists as they navigate their postpartum experience. She Matters trains therapists and healthcare professionals to be better resources for Black mamas, by ensuring they are aware of the healing challenges faced by Black women and removing the cultural stigma and medical neglect associated with mental illness in the Black community.

The Beans is a financial wellness platform that simplifies the path to financial balance through design and technology, helping people stress less about money and focus more on what they love. By creating personalized, visual financial plans and supporting users with proactive, encouraging guidance, The Beans empowers individuals to build healthier money habits and achieve lasting peace of mind.

Scaling application security across modern development teams. Wabbi’s Continuous Security platform integrates with existing development workflows to empower development teams to actively build code with application security in mind. As privacy and data security become even bigger C-level priorities, Wabbi’s technology creates empowerment and accountability. Gone are the days when teams have to decide between security and agility. With Wabbi, they can have both.

WealthMore is building a more inclusive path to wealth with AI-powered tools and accessible financial advisory services. By combining intelligent technology, expert guidance, and community support, WealthMore makes it easier to build the wealth and the life you want. With investment portfolios managed by real wealth advisors, WealthMore empowers people to make confident financial decisions with clarity and purpose.

Womaness is a women’s wellness brand modernizing the experience of aging, offering clinically and doctor-tested supplements, sexual wellness, and skincare products tailored to the needs of women over 40. Created by women for women, Womaness delivers evidence-based solutions for symptoms like hot flashes, crepey skin, vaginal dryness, sleepless nights, and more. Womaness empowers women to feel and look great as they age with confidence, clarity, and the support they deserve.
